name: Far East Bio-Tec Co., Ltd.
summary: Far East Bio-Tec Co., Ltd. is a Taiwanese enterprise, founded in 1976 and headquartered in Taipei. The company is a significant producer and distributor of various health and wellness items, including organic chlorella, spirulina, and a wide array of dietary supplements. Its comprehensive product line further encompasses nutraceuticals, immune-boosting solutions, antiviral sprays, and specialized nutritional aids for pets.
